description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Swipe (mouse drag) from [x,y] to [x,y] over an optional duration in ms, for gestures such as Home Screen paging; to move a list use phone_scroll. Refused with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed. Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_swipe
